title: A charted log map with invertible stalk has a local right inverse
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\bar x$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $(N,\alpha_N)$ and $(M,\alpha_M)$ be log structures on $X$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Let $f:N\to M$ be a homomorphism of sheaves of monoids with $\alpha_M f=\alpha_N$; thus it is a homomorphism of log structures over the identity of $X$ and fixes $\mathcal O_X^\times$. Let $Q$ be a finitely generated commutative monoid and let $q:Q\to M(X)$ be a chart [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Suppose the induced homomorphism $f_{\bar x}:N_{\bar x}\to M_{\bar x}$ of geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is an isomorphism. Then there is an affine pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)\to(X,\bar x)$ [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and a monoid homomorphism $k:Q\to N(V)$ such that
$$\alpha_N k=\alpha_M(q|_V),\qquad (f|_V)k=q|_V,\qquad k_{\bar v}=f_{\bar x}^{-1}q_{\bar x}.$$
There is a unique homomorphism of log structures $g:M|_V\to N|_V$ over the identity of $V$ with $g(q|_V)=k$, and it satisfies
$$(f|_V)g=\mathrm{id}_{M|_V},\qquad g_{\bar v}=f_{\bar x}^{-1}.$$
The stalk equalities use the canonical identifications along the pointed etale map. Neither a finite chart on $N$ nor finite generation of the unit sheaves is assumed, and $Q$ need not be integral or saturated.

proof.text: Put $h=f_{\bar x}^{-1}q_{\bar x}:Q\to N_{\bar x}$. Apply the finite-monoid stalk-data spreading lemma with $P=Q$, $F=N$ and initial pointed neighbourhood $(X,\bar x)$. Its lifting clause gives an affine pointed etale refinement $(U,\bar u)$ and a monoid homomorphism $k_0:Q\to N(U)$ with germ $h$. Its restriction-stalk compatibility identifies this germ with $h$ under all subsequent pointed refinements. The lemma applies to arbitrary finitely generated commutative $Q$ and does not require a chart on $N$.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p. 69, and 3.7(a), printed p. 75, final chart-extension sentence; agent-written details of its finite-chart inverse lift.

proof.text: The homomorphisms $f_Uk_0,q|_U:Q\to M(U)$ have the same germ, since $f_{\bar x}h=q_{\bar x}$. Apply the equality clause of the same finite-monoid lemma with $F=M$. On a further affine pointed refinement $(V,\bar v)$ they agree. Set $k=k_0|_V$; then $(f|_V)k=q|_V$ and $k_{\bar v}=h$. Since $f$ respects structure maps, $\alpha_Nk=\alpha_M(f|_V)k=\alpha_M(q|_V)$. This derives the structure-map equality without any finiteness assertion about units. The refinement is locally Noetherian by the same lemma.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p. 69, and 3.7(a), printed p. 75, final chart-extension sentence; agent-written details of its finite-chart inverse lift.

proof.text: Write $\beta=\alpha_M(q|_V)$. By the associated-log restriction and chart clauses, $q|_V$ identifies $M|_V$ with $L_V(Q,\beta)$. The universal-property bijection for this associated log structure, with target $N|_V$, applies to $k$ because $\alpha_Nk=\beta$. It gives exactly one homomorphism of log structures $g:M|_V\to N|_V$ over $V$ with $g(q|_V)=k$; it fixes $\mathcal O_V^\times$.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p. 69, and 3.7(a), printed p. 75, final chart-extension sentence; agent-written details of its finite-chart inverse lift.

proof.text: The two log homomorphisms $(f|_V)g$ and $\mathrm{id}_{M|_V}$ agree on $q|_V$, because $(f|_V)g(q|_V)=(f|_V)k=q|_V$. Injectivity of the same universal-property bijection, now with target $M|_V$, makes them equal. On the marked stalk this gives $f_{\bar x}g_{\bar v}=\mathrm{id}$ under the identifications fixed in step 1. Composing with $f_{\bar x}^{-1}$ gives $g_{\bar v}=f_{\bar x}^{-1}$. Together with $k_{\bar v}=h$ from step 2, these are all the required clauses.

lean.statement: theorem EtaleLogStructure.exists_local_rightInverse_of_chart {X : Scheme.{max u v}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (N M : EtaleLogStructure X) (f : N.monoidSheaf ⟶ M.monoidSheaf) (hf : f.hom ≫ M.alpha = N.alpha) {Ω : Type (max u v)} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) {Q : Type v} [CommMonoid Q] (hQ : Monoid.FG Q) (q : Q →* M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))) (hq : M.IsChart (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) (q.comp (MulEquiv.ulift : ULift.{u, v} Q ≃* Q).toMonoidHom)) [IsIso (N.toEtalePrelogStructure.mapStalk M.toEtalePrelogStructure f t)] : ∃ (V : X.Etale) (w : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj V) (k : Q →* N.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op V)), IsAffine V.left ∧ (N.alpha.app (op V)).hom.comp k = (M.alpha.app (op V)).hom.comp (M.restrictGlobalChart q V) ∧ (f.hom.app (op V)).hom.comp k = M.restrictGlobalChart q V ∧ (N.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t V w).hom.comp k = (inv (N.toEtalePrelogStructure.mapStalk M.toEtalePrelogStructure f t)).hom.comp ((M.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t V w).hom.comp (M.restrictGlobalChart q V)) ∧ ∃ g : (Over.forget V).op ⋙ M.monoidSheaf.obj ⟶ (Over.forget V).op ⋙ N.monoidSheaf.obj, (g ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op N.alpha = Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op M.alpha) ∧ (g.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).hom.comp (M.restrictGlobalChart q V) = k ∧ (∀ g' : (Over.forget V).op ⋙ M.monoidSheaf.obj ⟶ (Over.forget V).op ⋙ N.monoidSheaf.obj, g' ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op N.alpha = Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op M.alpha → (g'.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).hom.comp (M.restrictGlobalChart q V) = k → g' = g) ∧ g ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op f.hom = 𝟙 _ ∧ ∀ (W : X.Etale) (a : W ⟶ V) (z : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj W), (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.map a z = w → ∀ s : M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W), N.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t W z (g.app (op (Over.mk a)) s) = inv (N.toEtalePrelogStructure.mapStalk M.toEtalePrelogStructure f t) (M.toEtalePrelogStructure.germ t W z s)
